tasks.label: preflight: Startup.ps1 services
tasks.detail: Verifies that Startup.ps1 has already started Fabric, Foundry, Flow, and the Vite UI before browser debugging starts.
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $urls = @('http://127.0.0.1:7878/health', 'http://127.0.0.1:7979/health', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/health', 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/components/fabric-studio/workspace'); foreach ($url in $urls) { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if ($response.StatusCode -lt 200 -or $response.StatusCode -ge 500) { throw "HTTP $($response.StatusCode)" }; Write-Host "Ready: $url" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { throw "Startup.ps1 must be running before debugging Unfurl UI. Missing or unhealthy: $url. From unfurl-ui, run: .\Startup.ps1" } }
